# Volume V: Automation, Building Management, and Telecommunication Infrastructure

This volume examines Extra-Low Voltage (ELV) physical security, dual diverse Meet-Me Room (MMR) structured cabling pathways, Direct Digital Control (DDC) I/O point quantification, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM).
